title: Blue beings appearing at Joe Dispenza's retreats and meditations

tellings.quote: Despensza says that in his uh you know deep meditations, blue beings show up in the room and they tell him that the the collective the people in the conference need to vibrate higher in order for the blue beings to fully manifest and heal

plain: Blue beings are said to show up in the room during the deep meditations of Joe Dispenza, a meditation teacher who runs large retreats and conferences. According to Dispenza, they tell him the people at the conference need to "vibrate higher" before the beings can fully appear and heal. Michels tells this himself, passing on what Dispenza has said. If true, it would mean non-human beings respond to a crowd's state of mind.
